cluster_label: body_16-cell germline cyst in germarium region 2a and 2b
working_definition: Female germline cyst cells of the 16-cell stage in germarium regions 2a/2b of the adult ovary (Li et al. 2022, Manual Annotation; broad class female germline cell).
searches_performed: 16-cell germline cyst in germarium region 2a and 2b

best_match.fbbt_term: cyst cell of female germline 16-cell cyst
best_match.fbbt_definition: One of the 16 cyst cells that make up a female germline 16-cell cyst, resulting from the fourth and last round of cystoblast division (Hinnant et al., 2020).

justification: The label names the 16-cell germline cyst in the germarium; the cluster is composed of its cyst cells, which FBbt has as a specific cell term. The region qualifier is a location detail not captured by the term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Cyst composed of 16 cyst cells following the division of each cyst cell in an 8-cell cyst.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Multicellular structure, not a cell term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Cell that develops into or is itself an egg.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Too broad; a specific cell term exists.
